# Lemon Squeezy shutdown: where are indie software sellers moving?

(Confirmed — November 16, 2026)

Yes. Lemon Squeezy is officially winding down. This is no longer just a rumor.

According to the company's announcement\:

- **November 16, 2026\:** New store registrations closed.
- **December 2, 2026\:** Stripe migration tooling launches.
- **Mid-January 2027\:** Recommended latest date to begin migration.
- **March 31, 2027\:** Lemon Squeezy stops processing all transactions, including subscription renewals.

The reason: Stripe is consolidating Lemon Squeezy into its own **Stripe Managed Payments** product. [www.lemonsqueezy.com](https://www.lemonsqueezy.com/blog/saying-goodbye-to-lemon-squeezy?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[docs.lemonsqueezy.com](https://docs.lemonsqueezy.com/migration?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

The interesting part is that there isn't one universal replacement. The alternatives depend on whether you're selling SaaS, downloadable software, license keys, or digital products.

## The main migration destinations

![Stripe Logo Download (SVG, PNG, EPS, PDF) | PixelBrands](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aVtuLxJXV9DmtEmg9b45Apl_aIYsif99dM-GHSfkXYZDC4tFOhFvFlTrHocFw_PqD4iGlfn8TyGj8Knz3iEfgQ88Gl1qbf-qVS8yq3s_dga8IuVvdS85dQWTHuxQAfDBHQSn4bvLAWea6XSgqDlmrU-sz5LlptntGZmOFqqabVil8_uydbbIqAvaqwgrj-k8?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe Managed Payments**

(Official migration destination)

- Closest supported migration path for eligible Lemon Squeezy merchants.
- Merchant of record: yes.
- Handles international sales tax, fraud and disputes.
- Migration tooling planned for December 2, 2026.
- Missing built-in file delivery, license keys, storefronts and affiliates.

**Best fit\:** SaaS and digital-product sellers who want to stay within Stripe's ecosystem.

[Stripe Managed Payments](https://stripe.com/payments/managed-payments)

---

![Introducing the Creator Platform for Open Source Developers • changelog.gallery](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/6sK9rnkB4om5g4rgRjYwfXY5yp2JNz8Cfj74LhzLjxwntpmfMVdQYILtvj8sRAF1QbElHbii-FJLkb76oc5kP3gTKEP20cATGmJS_J7GDk4kGpgjWN9cXSXyjfGsNcMIAwzZ1bNfUYW-XgC9LOdx08cyO-6R-QedaVUTPt0ju60fEm5pZNZePx4Iw6QZuijj?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Polar**

(Developer-focused alternative)

- Merchant of record.
- Built around developer products, SaaS and open-source monetization.
- Supports subscriptions, one-time purchases and digital products.
- Developer-friendly APIs and integrations.

**Best fit\:** Indie hackers, developer tools, APIs and small SaaS businesses.

[Polar website](https://polar.sh/)

---

![Paddle - Crunchbase Company Profile & Funding](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/mivzkrx43X7k8aTimMuWUKZzjhIdD9rLkTyf7bwU4HMixtl_3F8o-BpQqVSbUFTvf2Ji5pEzpAvJztrqJEL1vBhlfpOAVkpfeXIgsZkm7xd3j-E5-IqZ8EaDi-KQ7aL5LqM5PWh2IOxzxjzpAILNOfVp1CqoyQxaX0Akt3mhWps-MQ7E9V_cu71lmtzwiHvU?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Paddle**

- Established merchant of record.
- Subscription billing and global tax handling.
- Particularly relevant to SaaS companies.
- More established billing infrastructure than many newer indie-focused entrants.

**Best fit\:** SaaS businesses with recurring revenue and international customers.

[Paddle website](https://www.paddle.com/)

---

![Dodo Payments Logo PNG Vector (SVG) Free Download](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/78QKmfWuQpWV_ssMThvCXIcH5Tu7QHPzdNblZPKBoI8MGrvy0ArLpQzEFATV73JMyAjf5bI5BJcsf68R10vyql7rHl3WK1o6MwroZwn5vpCV9NNapPsozdj_w6t6ILPSwSw-HkRBCt5RuL3YhCHyi5q6CUyuYWMwRF_jwi_bQrxf0dkEQ4I89CVAyzNky0Bx?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Dodo Payments**

- Merchant of record.
- Targets digital products, SaaS and software businesses.
- Offers subscription billing and digital-product payment infrastructure.
- Worth investigating for sellers who need an alternative to Stripe.

**Best fit\:** International indie developers and software entrepreneurs.

[Dodo Payments website](https://dodopayments.com/)

---

![Creem](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/uAi-HwEu2VXddAG9Yy77YNAINxyzye4F6z971-jwz1nKHFXQhEKNYBKDq8IjWe_eWvvuqBfduUzjEz6bmu8pgUXXRg5AqvhOcLCJVnq-3z48-szmQ37Hrmq_ctQzmChKNWtnzp-ZwCfXSbk0njBwXOUiXSLb4yagANLNrUnBKhM6LEX43HRjMrIu9-yj6Xqj?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Creem**

- Merchant of record.
- Developer-oriented checkout and subscription infrastructure.
- A newer alternative being discussed in the indie software ecosystem.
- Advertised pricing starts at 3.9% + \$0.40.

**Best fit\:** Solo developers looking for a relatively lightweight payments platform.

[Creem website](https://www.creem.io/)

---

![202Как оплатить Gumroad из России в 2025 году? - 17.12.24 18:33 | Пикабу](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/H3PC_9yhIpZPMog0WjktmdGQmrk5LxapR48ZWhV58PIrUsVf5PJfhptOjMIAEROBAvSFYnSm9Mcb_d8VPNLxfXRqGEiBSCNvAj17yXG1aVRBlWnSVaamc2e3rlyByewhXzQ4KTZjv7MaE_HqXqFzv8o3aD4DLXibx6rdNFUiBaFpPTqlR_rDjxwO2qQRB6x3?purpose=fullsize)

**6\. Gumroad**

- Merchant of record.
- Easy digital-product storefront.
- Supports memberships and digital downloads.
- Higher headline transaction fees.

**Best fit\:** Selling downloadable products, templates, ebooks and smaller software products.

[Gumroad website](https://gumroad.com/)

These are credible alternatives being discussed in the wake of the announcement, not a verified ranking of actual migration volumes. There isn't yet reliable public data showing how many sellers have chosen each platform. [www.stateofindiehacking.com](https://www.stateofindiehacking.com/stories/lemon-squeezy-alternatives-shutdown/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[theknowledgeengineers.com](https://theknowledgeengineers.com/alternatives/lemon-squeezy?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.transactbridge.com](https://www.transactbridge.com/blog/best-lemon-squeezy-alternatives-for-global-businesses?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[goodvat.com](https://goodvat.com/blog/lemon-squeezy-alternatives/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## Important: license keys are the biggest migration complication

If you sell actual software (desktop apps, plugins, developer tools, etc.), don't just compare payment processors.

Lemon Squeezy bundled several jobs together\:

1. Payment processing
2. Merchant-of-record tax handling
3. Subscription management
4. License-key generation and validation
5. Digital downloads and fulfillment

Stripe Managed Payments does not replace all five.

For license-key-based software, **Bunny** is another interesting option. It offers subscription billing and license-key management, including online and offline license validation. However, it is not a merchant of record, so you'll need a separate tax solution.

[Bunny website](https://bunny.com/) · [bunny.com](https://bunny.com/blog/lemon-squeezy-is-shutting-down-move-your-subscriptions-and-license-keys/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[docs.lemonsqueezy.com](https://docs.lemonsqueezy.com/migration?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## Quick comparison

| Platform | Merchant of record | Developer-oriented |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Stripe Managed Payments | Yes | Yes |
| Polar | Yes | Yes |
| Paddle | Yes | Yes |
| Dodo Payments | Yes | Yes |
| Creem | Yes | Yes |
| Gumroad | Yes | Somewhat |
| Bunny | No | Yes |


## My take

For an indie software business, I'd investigate these three first\:

- **Polar\:** If you want a developer-centric alternative with a merchant of record.
- **Paddle\:** If you're running a more established SaaS business.
- **Dodo Payments\:** If you want another merchant-of-record option to evaluate.

I'd keep Stripe Managed Payments on the shortlist too, especially if you're eligible for the migration incentive.

One important caveat: moving to a regular payment processor instead of a merchant of record means taking responsibility for applicable sales tax and VAT obligations yourself.

## One question that would substantially change my recommendation

What kind of software are you selling?

**1\. Product type**
